csv_project_name: Engineer for Hwy 77 MN River Bridge Construction
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Minnesota , Department of Transportation , may be seeking a consultant to provide Construction Engineering services for Hwy 77 MN River Bridge rehabilitation project. Hwy 77 MN River Bridge Construction Engineer The minimum qualifications for the construction engineer are as follows: *Licensed engineer in the State of Minnesota now or within 3 months from contract award. *Experienced in the design and construction of bridge rehabilitation and repair projects *Experienced in the design and construction of post-tensioned bridge elements *Experienced in Geometry Control procedures for bridge construction *Must have a minimum of 8 years bridge experience including 5 years in construction and experience as a construction manager or project engineer on at least one major bridge.
